entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, the leader in performance cycling gear. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return. Order number 881-593-20-B.

Certainly. Let me just pull that up for you... Okay, I see the VeloPro Carbon cycling shoes. To make sure I handle this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?
Fit. They're causing blisters on my heels. I've tried adjusting the cleats, but it's no good. I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is critical, and getting blisters from new cycling shoes is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can absolutely help you with that.
So, yes or no? Can I return them?

Yes, of course. Your purchase was only 7 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy for apparel and shoes. I am processing the full refund for you now. I also see you're a VIP member with VeloFit, so I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee for you.
Good. That's what I needed. Where's the label?

I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once our warehouse scans it in, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Okay, that's fine. That's all I needed.
Perfect. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
